category_title: Infrequent communicators with one-word responses who tolerate but disengage from social interaction
minimal_context: The student and tutor are participating in a 1:1 interaction session using bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to do a bubble lesson today. Look at the bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows no interest in interacting with the adult and gives a one-word response) Bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Tell me what you want me to do with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the highly motivating item from the table to work away on his own agenda) Open.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Give the bubbles back to me right now. You need to sit still and listen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Protests immediately following the directive communication and turns away, exhibiting ignoring behaviours) No!
